steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Generate app-meta.json with Compile Fail Demo name and package.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with target SDK 34 and Java 1.8 compatibility.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest
steps.description: Define permissions and register MainActivity in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Design Layout UI
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml with user interface text detailing compile failure simulation.

steps.title: Create Java Package Directories
steps.description: Set up standard Java source directories for package com.compilefaildemo.app.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity Structure
steps.description: Initialize standard lifecycle hooks inside MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Introduce Deliberate Typo Error
steps.description: Add a deliberate compile-time syntax error inside MainActivity.java as requested by the user.

steps.title: Verify Resource References
steps.description: Ensure layout identifiers match resources exactly.

steps.title: Prepare Gradle Wrapper Config
steps.description: Ensure compatibility with Gradle 8.5 and Temurin JDK 17.

steps.title: Building Compile Fail Demo
steps.description: Execute gradle assembleDebug to trigger compilation. This step is expected to fail compile due to the user-requested typo.
